quantitative_claims.scientific_object: Definition of the charged moment that supplies the flux generating function.
quantitative_claims.paper_assertion: The charged moment is s_n(alpha)=Tr[rho_A^n exp(i alpha N_A)].
quantitative_claims.reason: Source definition retained for traceability but excluded from the independent-result denominator.

quantitative_claims.scientific_object: Block decomposition and exact sector sum.
quantitative_claims.paper_assertion: [N,rho]=0 implies [N_A,rho_A]=0, so rho_A is charge-block diagonal and s_n=sum_N s_n(N).
quantitative_claims.reason: Existing formula cards, independent data, or invariant checks directly adjudicate this result.

quantitative_claims.paper_assertion: Fourier projection of s_n(alpha) equals Tr[rho_A^n P_NA] for each charge sector.
quantitative_claims.reason: Existing formula cards, independent data, or invariant checks directly adjudicate this result.
